verdict.rationale: v0 is documented as an AI agent driven by chat. The SDK shows natural-language messages such as 'Build me a personal website' creating chats, and v0 plans and builds from those prompts; community users describe prompting it to generate apps. Missing for 10: explicit docs showing that non-generation operations (deploy, project management, GitHub actions) can be driven by natural-language commands rather than buttons or menus, and in-depth first-party documentation of the chat command surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: v0 is an AI agent that helps anyone create real code and full-stack apps and agents.
v0 plans, creates tasks, and connects to databases as it builds.
